ModMetaData.name: AgentDevTools
ModMetaData.author: sleepsheep
ModMetaData.description:
Precise tapping for the developer tools in the RimWorld 1.7 Android (Waylith) port.
The port plays taps on the map through its own touch layer, which reports a nearest object instead of the cell the finger is actually on - so debug tools (kill, destroy, damage, spawn) hit the wrong target or nothing at all.
This mod translates the tap into the exact cell and only snaps to an object when the finger really lands on it. Three modes (off / auto / always) via files/game/agentdevtools.mode; every click is logged with the decision it took.
No game file is modified; everything is applied at runtime with Harmony.
